title: Channel Maintenance in Southcrest
description:
The City’s Stormwater Department is prepping Southcrest ahead of storm season. Maintaining infrastructure like channels is crucial, especially with a predicted strong El Niño. Heavy machinery and hand crews are hard at work cleaning channels and helping create safer neighborhoods. 
 
If you see illegal dumping in storm channels, please report it on the City’s Get it Done app.  

#CityOfSanDiego #Southcrest #ENSO #ElNino
